name: d4-cms-core
description: Admin shell every content module plugs into: password login with optional TOTP 2FA, a dashboard that renders panels from the generated admin-panels registry, a libSQL-backed data store (src/lib/cms/data-store.ts, Turso in production / a local SQLite file in dev), a markdown renderer, and an authenticated image upload endpoint that stores files in Vercel Blob (falling back to public/uploads in dev).
clientFacingSummary: A private admin area where you sign in and edit your own site content, protected by a password and optional two-factor authentication.

env.name: ADMIN_PASSWORD
env.description: Password for the /admin login. Set a strong unique value per site; flag it rotate-before-handoff.

env.name: TOTP_SECRET
env.description: Base32 TOTP secret enabling two-factor login. When unset, login is password-only and /admin/setup-2fa explains how to enable it.

env.name: TURSO_DATABASE_URL
env.description: libsql:// URL of this client's Turso database. When unset, the CMS falls back to a local SQLite file under data/cms.db (dev only — not for production).

env.name: TURSO_AUTH_TOKEN
env.description: Auth token for TURSO_DATABASE_URL. Required whenever TURSO_DATABASE_URL is set.

env.name: BLOB_READ_WRITE_TOKEN
env.description: Vercel Blob store token for uploaded images/files. When unset, uploads fall back to public/uploads on local disk (dev only — not for production).

postAssemble.notes: Content modules (careers, insights, catalog, gallery) import from @/lib/cms/* and register panels into src/config/admin-panels.generated.tsx, which the builder rewrites. This module must be selected whenever any of those modules are selected.
